On 6/17/2013 11:47 AM, mohamed elgoussi wrote:
> Hi All,
> I have come accross a document published by UN ComTrade which is attached below.
> I think that all graphs are definitely done by R using Package (ggplot2). I
> am wondering if you could help me in producing Graph 3. I have good knowledge
> of using R, with poor knowledge in ggplot2 package.
> Thanks all.

Looking at those graphs, I doubt they were made with ggplot2. There are
two things about Figure 3 in particular that would be difficult to do:
the y axis is repeated on the right side, not just the left and some of
the fills use patterns (hatching), not just colors. Both of these could
easily be done in a post-processing step with an image manipulation
program, however.

The graph seems to be a pair of ecdf functions, one with the x-axis
mirrored. The vertical breaks are based on the data and could be
pre-computed.
